newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Eurobond prospectuses to go on-line -ISMA.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond prospectuses to go on-line -ISMA.

text.p: Prospectuses for new Eurobond issues will soon be available on-line, the International Securities Market Association (ISMA) said at its annual general meeting on Thursday.

In a joint initiative, the International Primary Market Association (IPMA) said it would recommend to lead managers that they provide ISMA with a standardised summary of the terms of new Eurobond issues at the time of launch and subsequently with new issue Eurobond prospectuses.
ISMA would make these available electronically on-line, it said.

"This service will enhance information available to the secondary market on new issues for the benefit of the international securities market as a whole," said John Dowsett, chairman of ISMA's market practices committee.
The service would be made available initially in nine countries representing the bulk of ISMA/IPMA membership, but would eventually extend beyond those countries.
The start date is scheduled for the autumn of this year.
ISMA is the self-regulatory industry body and trade association for the international securities market. It has 820 members in 51 countries.
